findings.finding: No single entry point. 16 top-level files overwhelm new users. User needs to know: README first, then USAGE_QUICKSTART, but no explicit 'START_HERE' marker.
findings.recommendation: Add DAILY_USE.md as the single entry point. Reference other docs from there.

findings.finding: POSITIONING.md (384 words) + EVIDENCE_BASIS.md (200 words) + BOUNDARY.md (200 words) overlap significantly. All three discuss what v0.4 is/isn't.
findings.recommendation: Consolidate positioning/boundary/evidence into POSITIONING.md. Keep EVIDENCE_BASIS for detailed benchmark data.

findings.finding: Draft duplicates: CHANGELOG_DRAFT.md (1266 bytes) and INSTALL_DRAFT.md (830 bytes) coexist with RC versions CHANGELOG.md and INSTALL.md. Confusing.
findings.recommendation: Remove CHANGELOG_DRAFT.md and INSTALL_DRAFT.md from RC. Keep only RC versions.

findings.finding: Factory Lite Core is default (Tier 0) but explanation is spread across README, POSITIONING, and manual-index.json.
findings.recommendation: DAILY_USE.md should state this once, clearly, at the top.

findings.finding: INSTALL.md (411 bytes, ~50 words) is concise but works. INSTALL_DRAFT.md (830 bytes) is redundant.
DO_NOT_CLAIM_UNIVERSAL_QUALITY.md (609 bytes) is a good gate. Positioning preserved correctly.
RELEASE_NOTES_RC.md + CHANGELOG.md + VALIDATION_CHECKLIST.md — three files about release status. Could be two.
findings.recommendation: Merge VALIDATION_CHECKLIST into RELEASE_NOTES_RC or remove standalone checklist.

findings.finding: No MINIMAL_CONTEXT_PACKET exists. User must read ~1800 words across 16 files to understand v0.4 baseline.
findings.recommendation: Create MINIMAL_CONTEXT_PACKET.md under 1500 words as the single daily-use reference.

summary: RC is functional but has usability issues: too many files (16 top-level), draft duplicates, no single entry point. Core mechanisms are well-structured. Primary fixes: add DAILY_USE.md, MINIMAL_CONTEXT_PACKET.md, remove draft duplicates, consolidate overlapping docs.
title: RC Usability Audit
